english.title: Act as qualified air traffic controller / student air traffic controller having failed assessment / test / exam
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having, when last

(A)_[examined]_
(B)_[assessed]_
(C)_[tested]_

for the purposes of Chapter 2 of the Air Navigation Order 2016, failed that

(D)_[examination,]_
(E)_[assessment,]_
(F)_[test,]_

acted in the capacity for which that

(G)_[examination]_
(H)_[assessment]_
(I)_[test]_

english.legislation: Contrary to articles 193 and 265(5) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
having, when last examined, assessed or tested for the purposes of Chapter 2 of the Air Navigation Order 2016,
failed that examination, assessment or test,
acted in the capacity for which that examination, assessment or test
would have qualified you had it been passed
